items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer lists Yusef as a model alongside the interviewee, but the interviewee does not mention any personal interaction, collaboration, or relationship with Yusef in the provided text.

ctx.x: “And we’ll play your music too, and welcome.” And like that, so he embraced me. You know, Yusef had left or was leaving, and he wanted me to come and be in the sextet. And I think he’d had some denture work or something. I don’t know, he was a little... I don’t know if that was it, or what, but he still wanted to keep a tenor in the band. His welcome was so beautiful. The beautiful thing about those two leaders: I had Chico, he was a man of, [Imitating Chico]: “Yes, you know jazz, you know. You can stay with me…
